g.title: The selected exact recovery outcome is established and attributable, without replaying semantic operations against newer content or rolling back acknowledged success.
Only transaction-created content and empty created directories are removed; preexisting or externally added content remains.
Only supported completion/cleanup is available; saved success is not rolled back.
The system stops without guessed repair, conversion, or overwrite of the foreign state.
The system reports the bounded stop or remaining recovery state and permits an explicit later attempt with refreshed recovery identity.
